turnstile.title: Turnstile control
turnstile.description: Model a turnstile as a Moore machine with states LOCKED and UNLOCKED. COIN unlocks a locked turnstile and leaves an unlocked one unchanged. PASS locks an unlocked turnstile and has no effect while locked. Outputs are 0/LOCKED and 1/FREE. Complete the transition and output tables, binary encodings, encoded tables, and state diagram.

elevator.title: Elevator control
elevator.description: Model a two-floor elevator with states EG_CLOSED, EG_OPEN, OG_CLOSED, and OG_OPEN. OPEN and CLOSE control the door. GO_OG and GO_EG move the elevator only while the door is closed; movement commands have no effect while it is open. Complete the Moore transition table and state diagram.

barrier.title: Parking garage barrier
barrier.description: Model a parking garage barrier with an always-open guest mode and a card-controlled mode. In card mode, VALID_CARD opens the barrier and PASS closes it after the induction loop detects the vehicle. Rework the behavior as a Moore machine and define suitable state-dependent output actions.

vending.title: Vending machine
vending.description: Model a vending machine accepting 50-cent and 1-euro coins for drinks costing 1.00 and 1.50 euros. START has no effect below 1 euro, extra coins at 1.50 euros are returned, and CANCEL returns the full credit. Determine events and actions, handle every event in every state, mark the initial state, and express the behavior as a Moore machine.

wiper.title: Windshield wiper control
wiper.description: Develop a Moore control system for windshield wipers with off, single-wipe, continuous, and rain-sensor modes. Driver controls and the rain signal are events. Define state-dependent motor outputs for stopping, wiping once, and continuous wiping, then complete the state diagram.

alarm.title: Alarm system
alarm.description: Model an alarm system with OFF, ARMED, and ALARM states. ON arms the system, the door sensor triggers a continuous alarm only while armed, and OFF switches the system off and stops an active alarm. Define the initial state, complete all transitions, and add suitable Moore outputs.

cruise.title: Cruise control
cruise.description: Model simplified cruise control with OFF, READY, and ACTIVE states. ON_OFF controls power, SET activates regulation, braking or accelerating deactivates it, RESET resumes the stored speed, CANCEL deactivates it, and PLUS/MINUS adjust the speed while active. Abstract from the concrete speed value and define suitable Moore outputs.

edgeDetector.title: Rising-edge detector
edgeDetector.description: Design a Mealy machine that emits RISING_EDGE only when the input signal changes from 0 to 1. An unchanged signal or a falling edge emits NO_PULSE.

doorController.title: Door control with action pulses
doorController.description: Model a locked and an unlocked door as a Mealy machine. CARD emits UNLOCK_PULSE only when it unlocks the door; PASS emits LOCK_PULSE only when it locks the door again. Events without an effect emit NO_ACTION.

sequenceDetector.title: 01 sequence detector
sequenceDetector.description: Design an overlap-capable Mealy machine that reports immediately for every input bit whether that bit completes the sequence 01. Consecutive zeros must remain a possible start of the next match.

parityTracker.title: Serial parity output
parityTracker.description: Design a Mealy machine that outputs the parity of all ones read so far after every input bit. A zero preserves parity; a one toggles between EVEN_PARITY and ODD_PARITY.

moore.title: Moore machines
moore.examplesDescription: State-dependent output: the current state determines the output independently of the input symbol currently being read.
moore.exercisesDescription: Construct machines whose outputs are associated exclusively with states.

mealy.title: Mealy machines
mealy.examplesDescription: Transition-dependent output: the example detects the bit sequence 101, including overlapping matches, and emits MATCH_101 on the transition that completes a match.
mealy.exercisesDescription: Construct machines with immediate outputs that depend on both the current state and the input.

examples.mooreDescription: A Moore machine with four states and two input symbols.
examples.mealyDescription: A three-state Mealy sequence detector recognizes 101, including overlapping matches. It emits NO_MATCH or MATCH_101 directly on every transition; the bundled input contains two matches.

title: Moore & Mealy Machines
description: Explore sequential circuit design with Moore and Mealy state machines. Learn the differences and when to apply each model.
